title: sheynkmanlab/lrp2 pipeline parameters
description: Long-read proteogenomics pipeline for PacBio Iso-Seq data

input_output_options.title: Input/Output Options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the sample files. Required columns: 'sample_name', 'sample_path', 'condition', 'sample_type'. Each RNA sample must have a unique 'sample_name' value, which will be used to label count matrix columns. Protein samples with matching 'sample_name' and 'condition' will be grouped together for proteomics analysis.

dataset_name.help_text: This name will be used as a prefix for all output files. It should be a descriptive name for your project or experiment.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

reference_genome_options.title: Genome Reference Options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.description: Name of genome reference. This automatically populates the paths for the reference FASTA and GTF files if using GENCODE references.
genome.help_text: Use this parameter to specify a GENCODE reference by ID, which builds the full paths for the reference FASTA, GTF, and protein FASTA, e.g. `--genome GRCh38.p14.v47`. Available IDs are defined in `conf/gencode_references.config`. Defaults to `GRCh38.p14.v49` if not specified. To use custom references instead, provide `--fasta` and `--gtf` directly along with `--species`.

gtf.description: Path to custom reference GTF file (optional).
gtf.help_text: Path to the GTF file matching your reference genome. If not provided, will be automatically set from iGenomes configuration using the genome parameter.

fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file (optional).
fasta.help_text: Path to the genome FASTA file matching your reference genome. If not provided, will be automatically set from iGenomes configuration using the genome parameter.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

isoseq_collapse_options.title: S1 PacBio IsoCall Options
isoseq_collapse_options.description: Options for the PacBio IsoCall transcript calling module.

isocall_config.description: Path to IsoCall configuration TOML file.
isocall_config.help_text: Configuration file for IsoCall parameters. Uses default config if not specified.

s1_alignment_threads.description: Number of alignment threads for pbmm2 (-j parameter).
s1_alignment_threads.help_text: Specifies the number of threads for alignment in pbmm2. If not specified, defaults to 75% of available CPUs allocated to the process.

s1_alignment_sorting_threads.description: Number of sorting threads for pbmm2 (-J parameter).
s1_alignment_sorting_threads.help_text: Specifies the number of threads for BAM sorting in pbmm2. If not specified, defaults to 25% of available CPUs allocated to the process.

sqanti_transcript_options.title: S2 Transcriptome Options
sqanti_transcript_options.description: Options for the SQANTI3 QC and filtering modules.

generate_hashids_script.description: Path to hash ID generation R script.
generate_hashids_script.help_text: R script used to generate hash IDs for transcripts.

filter_script.description: Path to SQANTI filtering R script.
filter_script.help_text: R script used to filter SQANTI3 QC output.

hashlib_script.description: Path to hashlib ID generator Python script.
hashlib_script.help_text: Python script used to generate hash IDs for transcripts.

sqanti_path.help_text: Path to the SQANTI3 cupcake utilities directory.

protein_coding_filter.description: Filter to keep only protein-coding genes.

internal_priming_filter.description: Filter to remove internal priming artifacts.

template_switching_filter.description: Filter to remove template switching artifacts.

percent_polya_threshold.description: Threshold for polyA percentage downstream of TTS.

transcript_class_keep.description: Comma-separated transcript structural categories to retain (FSM, ISM, NIC, NNC, or 'ALL').

predicted_proteome_options.title: S3 Predicted Proteome Options
predicted_proteome_options.description: Options for CPAT ORF calling and protein classification.

species.description: Species for CPAT model selection (human or mouse).

human_hexamer.description: Path to human hexamer table for CPAT.
human_hexamer.help_text: Hexamer table used by CPAT for ORF prediction in human samples.

human_logit_model.description: Path to human logit model for CPAT.
human_logit_model.help_text: Logit model used by CPAT for ORF prediction in human samples.

mouse_hexamer.description: Path to mouse hexamer table for CPAT.
mouse_hexamer.help_text: Hexamer table used by CPAT for ORF prediction in mouse samples.

mouse_logit_model.description: Path to mouse logit model for CPAT.
mouse_logit_model.help_text: Logit model used by CPAT for ORF prediction in mouse samples.

cpat_coding_threshold.help_text: Coding probability threshold for CPAT. Auto-set based on species if not specified (human=0.364, mouse=0.44).

top_orf.description: Number of top ORFs to retain per transcript.

filter_cpat_script.description: Path to CPAT filtering R script.
filter_cpat_script.help_text: R script used to filter CPAT output and call best ORFs.

sqanti_protein_script.description: Path to SQANTI protein classification Python script.
sqanti_protein_script.help_text: Python script used for SQANTI3 protein classification.

protein_class_script.description: Path to protein classification R script.
protein_class_script.help_text: R script used for 5'UTR and protein classification.

protein_class_keep.description: Comma-separated list of protein classifications to keep.
protein_class_keep.help_text: Protein classification categories to retain (e.g., FPM,IPM,NPC,NPE).

min_junctions_after_stop_codon.description: Minimum number of junctions after stop codon for filtering.

differential_analysis_options.title: S4 Multisample Analysis Options
differential_analysis_options.description: Options for multi-sample differential expression and splicing analysis.

min_samples_per_intron.description: Minimum number of samples per intron for leafcutter differential splicing.

min_samples_per_group.description: Minimum number of samples per group for leafcutter differential splicing.

min_usage_ratio.description: Minimum junction usage ratio for minicutter filtering.

lr_leafcutter_script.description: Path to long-read leafcutter R script.
lr_leafcutter_script.help_text: R script used for long-read leafcutter clustering analysis.

leafcutter_ds_script.description: Path to leafcutter differential splicing Python script.
leafcutter_ds_script.help_text: Python script used for leafcutter differential splicing analysis (leafcutter_ds.py).

multisample_script.description: Path to multi-sample analysis R script.
multisample_script.help_text: R script used for differential expression and usage analysis with edgeR and DRIMSeq.

leafcutter_threads.description: Number of threads for leafcutter differential splicing.
leafcutter_threads.help_text: Specify the number of threads to use for leafcutter differential splicing analysis. If not specified, defaults to using the number of CPUs allocated to the process (12 for process_high).

drimseq_min_gene_expr.description: Minimum gene-level expression for DRIMSeq filtering.
drimseq_min_gene_expr.help_text: Genes with total counts below this threshold will be filtered out before differential usage analysis.

drimseq_min_isoform_prop.description: Minimum isoform/feature proportion for DRIMSeq filtering.
drimseq_min_isoform_prop.help_text: Isoforms/features with proportion below this threshold will be filtered out before differential usage analysis.

multisample_only_inputs.title: Multisample Analysis Only Mode
multisample_only_inputs.description: Parameters for running only multisample analysis with pre-computed inputs from a previous LRP2 run.
multisample_only_inputs.help_text: Use these parameters to re-run only the multisample analysis subworkflow using outputs from a previous full pipeline run. All four file parameters must be provided together to enable this mode. The --input samplesheet parameter is not required in this mode.

transcripts_gtf.description: Pre-computed filtered GTF file from TRANSCRIPTOME subworkflow.
transcripts_gtf.help_text: Path to the filtered GTF file (typically named *_corrected_filtered.gtf) from a previous LRP2 run. This file is output by the FILTER_TRANSCRIPTOME module in the TRANSCRIPTOME subworkflow.

transcript_counts.description: Pre-computed transcript count matrix from TRANSCRIPTOME subworkflow.
transcript_counts.help_text: Path to the transcript count matrix file (typically named *_hashids_with_cpm_filtered.txt) from a previous LRP2 run. This file contains CPM-normalized transcript counts.

orf_counts.description: Pre-computed ORF count matrix from PREDICTED_PROTEOME subworkflow.
orf_counts.help_text: Path to the ORF count matrix file (typically named *.predicted.proteome.high_confidence_ORF_cpm.txt) from a previous LRP2 run. This file contains CPM-normalized ORF counts.

multisample_metadata.description: RNA sample metadata CSV file for multisample analysis.
multisample_metadata.help_text: Path to a CSV file with RNA sample metadata. Accepts two formats: (1) Simplified format with columns 'name', 'sample_path', 'group', 'sample_type', or (2) Standard samplesheet format with columns 'sample_name', 'sample_path', 'condition', 'sample_type', 'mass_spec_type'. The pipeline auto-detects which format you're using. You can use the auto-generated *_rna_samples_metadata.csv file from a previous LRP2 run, your original samplesheet (if RNA-only), or a custom metadata file in either format.

proteomics_options.title: S5 Proteomics Options
proteomics_options.description: Options for mass spectrometry proteomics analysis.

metamorpheus_config.description: Path to MetaMorpheus task configuration TOML file.
metamorpheus_config.help_text: Configuration file specifying MetaMorpheus search parameters (mass tolerance, modifications, FDR thresholds, etc.).

msconvert_peak_picking.description: Apply peak picking filter during MS file conversion.
msconvert_peak_picking.help_text: When enabled, applies vendor peak picking algorithm during conversion from raw to mzML format.

protein_fasta.description: Path to reference protein FASTA file.
protein_fasta.help_text: Reference protein database for proteomics searches. If not provided and a GENCODE genome is specified, will automatically use the protein FASTA from the GENCODE genome configuration.

no_gencode.description: Exclude GENCODE reference from proteome database.
no_gencode.help_text: When enabled, only LRP-predicted or custom protein sequences will be used for proteomics searches, excluding GENCODE reference proteins.

S5_custom_protein_fasta.description: Path to a protein FASTA for the proteomics search database.
S5_custom_protein_fasta.help_text: Protein FASTA used to build the search database. Accepts LRP2 pipeline output (headers: transcript_id|gene_id|gene_name|pclass|status) or any custom FASTA (headers: transcript_id|gene_id at minimum); the source is auto-detected. Use this for proteomics-only runs, or to override the FASTA generated upstream.

S5_custom_cds_gtf.description: Path to a GTF with CDS entries, paired with S5_custom_protein_fasta.
S5_custom_cds_gtf.help_text: GTF containing CDS entries, used to map peptides to genomic coordinates for the novel peptide BED output. Transcript IDs must match those in S5_custom_protein_fasta.

S5_custom_counts.description: Path to a transcript count matrix for filtering the proteomics search database.
S5_custom_counts.help_text: Non-GENCODE transcripts with CPM > 0 are retained; GENCODE entries are always kept in full. Column 1 must contain transcript IDs matching S5_custom_protein_fasta, and the CPM column name must contain the protein sample_name from the samplesheet. Only used for proteomics-only runs; on a full run the count matrix is generated by the pipeline.

protein_search.description: Protein search engine to use for proteomics analysis.
protein_search.help_text: Choose between 'fragpipe' (supports DDA and DIA) or 'metamorpheus' (DDA only).

fragpipe_tools_dir.description: Directory to store FragPipe tools (MSFragger, IonQuant, DiaTracer).
fragpipe_tools_dir.help_text: Location where FragPipe JAR files will be cached. These files are downloaded once and reused in future runs.

fragpipe_first_name.description: User's first name for FragPipe registration (optional for interactive mode).
fragpipe_first_name.help_text: Required for non-interactive FragPipe setup. Leave empty for interactive mode.

fragpipe_last_name.description: User's last name for FragPipe registration (optional for interactive mode).
fragpipe_last_name.help_text: Required for non-interactive FragPipe setup. Leave empty for interactive mode.

fragpipe_email.description: Email address for FragPipe registration (optional for interactive mode).
fragpipe_email.help_text: Required for non-interactive FragPipe setup. Leave empty for interactive mode.

fragpipe_institution.description: Institution/organization for FragPipe registration (optional for interactive mode).
fragpipe_institution.help_text: Required for non-interactive FragPipe setup. Leave empty for interactive mode.

fragpipe_token.description: 6-digit verification token for FragPipe (optional for interactive mode).
fragpipe_token.help_text: Required for non-interactive FragPipe setup. You'll receive this via email after registration. Leave empty for interactive mode.

fragpipe_license_accept.description: Accept FragPipe license terms (required for non-interactive mode).
fragpipe_license_accept.help_text: Set to true to accept FragPipe license terms for non-interactive setup.

fragpipe_workflow.description: Path to custom FragPipe workflow file (optional).
fragpipe_workflow.help_text: Custom .workflow file for FragPipe. If not provided, default workflows will be auto-downloaded (LFQ-MBR for DDA, DIA_SpecLib_Quant for DIA).

fragpipe_threads.help_text: Number of threads for FragPipe analysis. If not specified, defaults to using task.cpus from process label.

fragpipe_decoy_tag.description: Decoy tag prefix for protein database.
fragpipe_decoy_tag.help_text: Prefix used to identify decoy sequences in the protein database.

hpc_cluster_options.title: HPC cluster options
hpc_cluster_options.help_text: These parameters can override default executor settings in slurm.config or lsf.config.

hpc_executor.help_text: Specify the executor to use for job submission on HPC clusters.

hpc_queue.description: Override queue/partition name for job submission.
hpc_queue.help_text: Specify the queue or partition to use for job submission on HPC clusters.

hpc_cluster_options.help_text: Additional cluster-specific options to pass to the job scheduler.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
